title: J065--NuTrace Laser Etching Preventative Maintenance - Intent to  Sole Source
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.241-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 01 (36C241)
detail_text: Pre-Solicitation Notice for notice of intent to award a sole source contract. This is not a solicitation. The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to negotiate a sole source contract for 12 months with Martin AIJS LLC of 751 LYNNES CV WADSWORTH, OH 44281, an SDVOSB, to obtain Maintenance on the NuTrace Laser System for the VA Boston Healthcare System as the OEM designated service vendor. Since the intent is to procure this on a sole source basis, no solicitation will be posted to Contract Opportunities. The applicable NAICS code is 811210 with a $34MIL size standard. The PSC is J065. The authority for this action is FAR 6.302.1-1 Only One Responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. Interested persons may contact the Contract Specialist via email at David.Roy@va.gov regarding this procurement. The determination to conduct a competitive procurement based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Contracting Officer.
